text:
zoe (Docs): quick sync: i opened a migration PR that merges our 429 + timeout troubleshooting notes and adds a tiny SDK helper for context-trim on retry. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5077

reece (SRE): nice. does the doc distinguish burst-induced 429s vs sustained capacity 429s? we should show different repro commands and the header shapes (Retry-After vs X-RateLimit).

zoe (Docs): yes 1 split section: 'spike (fanout) 429' with a curl loop and 'capacity 429' with notes about larger Retry-After windows. added a short curl example to capture headers.

jamal (SDK): i'll add two snippets: a python backoff that respects Retry-After, and a JS streaming retry helper that trims oldest tokens using our tokenizer util. also will mention concurrent-retry caps.

zoe (Docs): sweet. can you keep the js helper opinionated about preferring summarization if >60% of context must be removed? PMs ask about fidelity tradeoffs.

jamal (SDK): done. small detail: recommend honoring Retry-After even if small (<0.5s), but add jitter to avoid thundering herd.

anya (PM): please include a one-line fallback routing example so customers know to route to lower-cost model under heavy load. also call out SLA implications.

zoe (Docs): added a short routing snippet and an SLA note. also linked to internal runbook anchor: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rl-429#migration-notes

reece (SRE): added a tiny repro command suggestion for dedicated pools and asked to ensure anchors point to the right runbook section.

zoe (Docs): fixed the anchor and updated the PR description. merging after final SDK lint pass. thanks!

merge-bot: zoe updated files: docs/troubleshooting/429-timeout-migration.md, snippets/trim_for_retry_js.js, snippets/backoff_respect_retry_py.py

zoe (Docs): request: @reece @jamal quick ack so i can merge before EOD.

reece (SRE): ack, will sanity-check dedicated numbers tomorrow AM.

jamal (SDK): ack, pushed lint fixes and a short comment about token-count differences across model families.

zoe (Docs): merging once CI green. :shipit:
